assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production transparent PNG building sprite for an illustrated fantasy tower-defense game, square 1024x1024.
Primary request: a magnificent arcane guardian tower for the Hall of White Thunder, an elegant high-fantasy lightning citadel rather than a chess rook or a UI icon. Single complete tower only.
Style: premium hand-painted 3D RPG game art, elevated orthographic three-quarter camera, crisp sculpted silhouette readable when displayed only 80 pixels tall, matching an ornate moonlit silver-blue ruined observatory.
Subject: a compact hexagonal ivory-stone and dark navy marble tower with gracefully tapered silver buttresses, restrained antique gold inlays, luminous icy blue conduits, a crown of three swept crystalline spires holding a levitating brilliant white-blue crystal. Strong stepped architectural base and readable large shapes; finely crafted but not noisy.
At the front center of the tower, about 60 percent down its total height, put a large circular navy inset medallion with a refined golden rim, perfectly blank and flat, for a game-rendered letter to be overlaid later. The blank medallion must be prominent and unobstructed.
Composition: whole building centered, fills 88 percent of image height and about 58 percent of width, comfortable transparent margin on all sides; base and highest crystal fully inside frame.
Lighting: cool moonlight with warm gold edges and small contained cyan glows, no huge halo.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No scene, no landscape, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no text, no letters, no UI, no border, no watermark, no extra objects, no sprite grid.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production transparent PNG projectile sprite for an illustrated fantasy tower-defense game, square 1024x1024.
Primary request: a beautiful enchanted crystal missile / magical arrow shot by an ivory-and-gold lightning guardian tower, pointed to the RIGHT along the exact horizontal centerline.
Subject: a single slender faceted ice-blue spearhead with a brilliant white core, miniature silver and antique-gold collar, two swept crystalline fins at its rear, a compact flowing cyan energy exhaust trailing to the LEFT. The solid pointed front on the right and the tapering energy trail on the left must read clearly at a 36 pixel displayed width. A fantasy magic missile, not a modern military rocket.
Style: polished hand-painted 3D fantasy RPG game sprite, crisp silhouette, high-quality faceted materials, restrained cyan/white/silver and gold palette matching a moonlit arcane observatory.
Composition: strictly horizontal straight projectile, centered vertically, fills 85 percent of image width and no more than 24 percent of image height, all parts comfortably inside the image, one projectile only.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha including around the glow; no square, no checkerboard painted into image, no scene, no ground, no letters, no text, no UI, no border, no watermark, no grid.
